column1: # examples/credentials.csv — a credential CSV (docs/CREDENTIAL-CSV.md).
# Copy it to ~/.karvi/credentials.csv and chmod 600: a user-scoped file is
# refused unless the operator owns it at mode 0600. The passwords here are
# placeholders. A line whose first byte is # is a comment; blank lines are
# skipped. Rows are read top to bottom and the first row whose selectors all
# match the device wins
column2: so a narrower row goes above a broader one.
